skill.name: seo-cannibalization-detector
skill.description: Analyzes provided pages for keyword, topic, metadata, and search intent overlap. Recommends consolidation, differentiation, canonical, and internal linking actions.
skill.summary: Find competing pages and create a prioritized plan to resolve SEO keyword cannibalization.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Competing pages can divide rankings and confuse search intent. This skill finds overlap and recommends consolidation, differentiation, canonical, and internal linking actions.
actual_capabilities: Compares provided page titles, descriptions, headings, keywords, and content focus.
Identifies keyword, topic, metadata, and search intent overlap between pages.
Builds a competing page inventory and keyword overlap matrix.
Prioritizes conflicts using supplied ranking and page performance context.
Recommends consolidation, differentiation, redirects, canonicals, and internal linking updates.
Suggests distinct target keywords and content angles for competing pages.
limitations: Analysis depends on complete and accurate page information supplied by the user.
The skill cannot verify live rankings or Search Console data unless those details are provided.
Similarity percentages are qualitative estimates, not measurements from a dedicated crawler.
Redirect, canonical, and internal linking changes require validation before implementation.

use_cases.title: Resolve Competing Blog Posts
use_cases.description: Compare similar articles and decide whether to merge, redirect, or assign distinct search intent.

use_cases.title: Audit Product Category Pages
use_cases.description: Find category pages targeting the same keywords and define unique metadata, scope, and internal links.

use_cases.title: Plan a Site Migration
use_cases.description: Map overlapping legacy pages to primary destinations and prepare consolidation, redirect, and canonical actions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Pages
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [page A] and [page B]. Identify overlapping keywords, search intent conflicts, and one clear action for each conflict.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused comparison of two similar pages.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Overlap Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [pages] using titles, descriptions, headings, keywords, rankings, and URLs. Return an overlap matrix and prioritized resolution list.
prompt_templates.scenario: A content team needs a structured audit across several pages.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Consolidation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a consolidation plan for [pages]. Select the primary page, redirects, canonical changes, retained sections, and internal link updates.
prompt_templates.scenario: An SEO manager needs implementation guidance for strongly overlapping content.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Topic Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [site section]. Cluster competing pages by intent, estimate overlap, prioritize risk, and create distinct keyword assignments.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced practitioner needs a site section strategy and prevention framework.

output_examples.input: Compare two guides targeting enterprise SEO software.
output: Intent overlap: both pages support commercial comparison.
Priority: high because both pages target the same buyer stage.
Action: merge evidence into one guide and redirect the weaker page.

output_examples.input: Review three pages about local keyword research.
output: Primary guide: broad local keyword research process.
Supporting page: tools and templates for implementation.
Supporting page: agency workflow for multiple locations.
Differentiate titles, headings, internal anchors, and calls to action.

output_examples.input: Prepare a cleanup plan for overlapping service pages.
output: Keep pages with distinct locations or service intent.
Consolidate pages that repeat the same offer and audience.
Add canonicals only when duplicate pages must remain accessible.
Review redirects, navigation, and internal links before release.

best_practices: Provide each page URL, title, description, headings, target keyword, and current ranking when available.
Confirm search intent before choosing consolidation or differentiation.
Validate redirects, canonicals, metadata, and internal links after implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not merge pages solely because they share several words.
Do not add canonicals without confirming the preferred page and technical requirements.
Do not assign the same primary keyword and intent to multiple pages.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide URLs, titles, descriptions, headings, target keywords, page text, rankings, and performance data when available.

faq.question: Can this skill crawl my website?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes page information supplied in the conversation or available through approved tools.

faq.question: Does keyword overlap always mean cannibalization?
faq.answer: No. Pages may share vocabulary while serving different search intent, audiences, locations, or stages.

faq.question: When should pages be consolidated?
faq.answer: Consolidate when pages serve the same intent, repeat substantial content, and lack a defensible unique purpose.

faq.question: Can it recommend redirects and canonicals?
faq.answer: Yes. Recommendations require technical review, performance checks, and validation against site architecture.

faq.question: How should I prevent future conflicts?
faq.answer: Maintain keyword assignments, review search intent before publishing, and audit content performance regularly.
